searchText: what would it take to move ERCs to their own repository? the task itself should be pretty doable (i'm willing to do it), mainly who needs to be convinced to make this happen? How would legacy ERC20 links be handled? We'd need to update how EIPs and ERCs are numbered Hmm, good point. Otherwise we could have a second ERC-20. My thinking is that the ERCs are moved to a separate repo exactly as is, numbers and all. On the EIPs repo we could leave in their places stub files `eip-x.md` "this ERC was moved to a separate repo, click here to be redirected". We would definitely need to update how the numbering works, probably would need to start using a spreadsheet to track numbers. Or just add 10,000 to the PR number? I suppose if we can spare some development time, we could just have the bot become aware of all of the already used numbers and simply skip them when they happen (and manually assign a different one).
